builtin.description: Overrides for SASE's builtin model aliases: default, coder, <provider>_coder, epic_lander, big_epic_lander, xsmall_phase_worker, small_phase_worker, medium_phase_worker, large_phase_worker, xlarge_phase_worker, smartest, smart, cheap, cheaper, and cheapest. Every registered <provider>_coder alias inherits coder unless explicitly overridden; see src/sase/llm_provider/model_alias_defaults.yml for the current shipped default of each alias. Values are bare known models, explicit provider/model targets, nested provider-local model paths, or '@<alias>' references; a reference may carry a trailing '@<effort>' that overrides the referenced alias's effort. Single-pipe values (A | B) form load-balanced round-robin pools; double-pipe values (A || B) form ordered provider-availability fallbacks. Operators cannot be mixed, and every member uses the same grammar and may carry a trailing @<effort>.
